title: boli maa kya hua sakina ko
body:
boli maa kya hua sakina ko
ghash ye kyu'n aa gaya sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
kyu'n ye qamosh ho gayi aaqair
kisne kya keh diya sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
kya qabar is ko kya hua beta
dekho abid zara sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
na shikaayat hai ab tamaacho'n ki
na rasan ka gila sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye ghurbat me cheen kar mujh se
le gayi kyu'n qaza sakina ko
